title: Employment Negotiations
text: And so, negotiation time had arrived. I settled into a chair at Panda and the others’ table.
“…So, what business do you have with us?”
“I want to hire you to do some work for me, indeed.”
“Employment… huh.”
Elephant murmured with a smile, Yuki-chan and Kou perched on her hand.
“Setting Elmelo here aside, you do realize you’re talking to me, right?”
“Of course, indeed.”

I understood Panda fairly well. She and Father actually got along, and apparently she was the type to take a strong liking to someone right from their first meeting. It seemed her first impression of him overlapped considerably with her first love—Tiger Guy’s father.
“Why am I being excluded? Well, I suppose it depends on the job. And the pay.”
“First, an advance payment—how about this?”

Thud. I dropped onto the table both the money pouch I’d set aside for purchasing Filolial-sama and a portion of the funds I’d borrowed from the Melromarc fortress. Impact matters in negotiations, after all.
“…Heh, quite the generous offer.”
Panda glanced at the money pouch while lazily sipping her drink.
“So, what’s the job?”
“I want you to come with me. And I want Panda to serve as Father’s bodyguard and, well, source of comfort, indeed.”
“Huh?”

Somewhere in my memory, Father and the others were lamenting that Motoyasu was terrible at negotiating, but that must have been my imagination. My negotiation skills may be inferior to Father’s, but they’re quite decent, I say!
“Panda… you mean Lars?”
“Say that to me again, I dare you.”
Oh? Did she not hear me the first time?
“I want you to come with me, indeed. And I want Panda to serve as Father’s bodyguard and comfort. That’s what I said, indeed.”
“Bodyguard and service?! Don’t screw with me. I’m no nursemaid for your father. Hire a professional for that sort of thing!”

I’m a mercenary! Panda declared, refusing with what seemed like genuine displeasure. Well, Father was technically my future father-in-law, indeed. “Nursemaid” was a bit much. I only wanted her to provide Father some comfort—was that really so different?
“You want me to do that too?”
Elephant asked, eyeing me warily.
“Guard duty, yes, but for you, Elephant, I’d like you to look after that child—Kou—and Filolial-sama.”
“Kyui-kyui!”
Yuki-chan and Kou bounced in front of Elephant, asserting themselves. Elephant gazed at them with gentle eyes.
“It’s important work, indeed. A guard mission for the great Father, the Shield Hero.”
Strange. Panda wasn’t biting.
“The Shield Hero? Yeah, right. Spare me. I’ve got no interest in that. Seriously, don’t joke with me. If you want to mock someone, go do it elsewhere.”
Panda stood abruptly and turned to leave.
“Please wait, indeed.”
The moment I said that, Panda flashed her claws and stopped right in front of me.
“Get lost before my hand digs into that face of yours. I want nothing to do with a job like that.”
Her hand landing on me wouldn’t really do much, honestly. Hmm… had the negotiation failed?

I could forcibly restrain and drag her along, but since Panda seemed to get along with Father, well—there was no helping it. I’d find an opportunity to have Father do the recruiting himself. Surely he could win her over properly. As Panda walked away, she turned back toward Elephant.
“Elmelo, you’re not coming?”
“Well, the money looks decent enough. I’ll decide after hearing a bit more.”
“Kyui-kyui!”
“Heh, you’re an odd one. Well, I’ll look forward to hearing how it went later.”
With that, Panda left the tavern along with her subordinates. Hmm… Panda was a failure, but Elephant seemed willing to listen.
“So, Elephant, will you accept the job?”
“Like I said, I’ll decide after hearing more. There are a few things that caught my interest.”
“Excellent, indeed. Then I’ll have you meet Father and Filolial-sama. I’d like you to teach them some fun songs, indeed.”
“Songs?!”
Elephant made a somewhat dubious face, but after glancing at Yuki-chan and the others chirping away, she gave a small cough.
“…Understood. First, please guide me there. I’ll make my decision after speaking with the target.”
“Of course, indeed. I’d like you to join the party.”
And so I invited Elephant into the party. She accepted right away.
“Then let’s meet up with my companions before joining Father.”
And with that, I brought Elephant along to rendezvous with the Siltvelt envoys.
“Oh? Spear Hero-sama, and who might this be?”
“A trustworthy, fine Elephant of mine, indeed. I’ve hired her, indeed.”
“…I am the mercenary Elmelo.”
She didn’t give her family name. She probably disliked it. More than anything, since these envoys were demi-humans, she likely found it troublesome to have her origins exposed through her surname.
“I see… and you’ll be bringing her along as well?”
“Of course, indeed. She’ll be playing nicely with Filolial-sama and the others, indeed.”
“I see… On our end, we’ve contacted the relevant departments, and the sale of the incoming slaves has been completed. What would you like done with the funds?”
“Since the source is unclear, moderate use is probably best. I’d like to pay Elephant her reward from these funds once we arrive, but I should consult Father on that.”
“Understood. Shall we head back, then?”
“Then let’s go, indeed! Portal Spear, indeed!”
And so we returned from Siltvelt to Father’s side. Naturally, I chose a location away from prying eyes for the rendezvous.
“Th-this is—?!”
Elephant seemed at a loss for words. Her eyes were practically spinning in her head.
“Shall we head over, then? Shield Hero-sama is waiting.”
The Siltvelt envoy began guiding Elephant with a wry smile.
“Kyui!”
Kou, apparently already fast friends with Elephant, bounced energetically atop her. Still wearing an expression of shock, I brought Elephant along back to Father.
“Ah, welcome back, everyone.”

Father appeared to be in the middle of some kind of meeting with the slaves inside the spread-out tent. Filolial-sama and the others were flying and hopping about freely at Father’s command. He stepped away from the three slaves and came toward us.
“Father, the slave trading in Siltvelt has been completed, indeed-phant.”
“I’ll reflect it here without drawing attention. The arrangements have already been made with the other party regarding the transaction.”
“Ah… right. Thanks, everyone. So then…”

Father’s gaze shifted to Elephant standing behind me. Elephant pressed her hands together, looking somewhat intimidated in Father’s presence. Now that I thought of it, even during the previous loop, she’d spoken as though something had clicked into place upon first meeting him. It seemed she sensed something.
“This Elephant is a fine elephant-phant.”
“Is that supposed to be one of your jokes, Motoyasu-kun?”
“She’s a truly fine one, so I called out to her over there and had her come work as a mercenary-phant.”
“Are you planning to explain everything with elephant puns? I get that she’s someone good you remembered, Motoyasu-kun, but… fine, I understand. First, introductions, right?”
Father turned to greet Elephant.
“My name is Naofumi Iwatani. Pleased to meet you.”
“It’s hard to believe all at once, but this is Melromarc, and this man truly is the Shield Hero-sama. Surely you’ve heard the rumors.”
You understand, don’t you? the Siltvelt envoy said to Elephant.
“Well… there are some circumstances right now that mean I can’t exactly go around announcing this work openly. I can’t say it proudly, but that’s how it is.”
“…I see. I understand the circumstances. Might I take it, then, that I have been fortunate enough to be invited into some unexpected, great and righteous undertaking?”
As expected of Elephant. Her quickness in grasping the situation was a great help.
“Whether it’s as grand as all that, I can’t really say, but… something like that, yeah.”
